caption: The drawing features a vertically oriented weather vane with a dark, slender shaft that has a pointed tip at the top. Mounted horizontally near the top of the shaft is an ornate, metallic arrow design, predominantly brown with hints of rust, featuring decorative scrollwork on the left side, a wavy tail shaped like a flag on the right, and a small eight-pointed star at the extreme right end. The weather vane's shaft passes through a round, metallic sphere near its midpoint, which appears brownish with patches of blue-gray and red coloration. The objects are depicted with realistic shading and rust-like texture, set against a plain off-white background with a thin red outline framing the entire drawing. In the bottom right corner is a small, simple line diagram showing the weather vane's profile and position relative to the main objects, annotated with basic measurements. The artist's name and date, "John Wall Del. 1859," are inscribed in small text at the lower left.
title: Weather Vane
